A.evidence: The card record is about 17 points below the roll call for students with a remote accommodation; their false-referral rate is 59% against 4% for other students with a registered disability.
A.fix: Feed approved remote attendance into the record, or exclude the attendance signal for these students until it is.
A.open: The 187 students with a registered disability and no remote accommodation are a small group: a moderate gap for them could hide inside the interval.

B.evidence: With a mark present, non-Saudi and Saudi students are missed at similar rates; with the mark missing, both are missed more than 70% of the time.
B.fix: Bring the bridging programme's midterm marks into the registry; until then report bridging-year entrants separately.
B.open: Whether the limits of 2023 fit bridging-year entrants once their marks are present cannot be known before the marks exist.
